FAQs

What type of wood used in Economy Tournament Chess Pieces?

To keep the costs of the Economy Tournament Chess Pieces low usually ebonized wood i.e. wood stained in black color is used. Sheesham wood is also a very beautiful and economical wood and so it is also used extensively in manufacturing of Economy Tournament Chess Pieces.

What is the standard size of these chess pieces that fall under this category?

Generally, the chess pieces in this category are 3.75" tall as this is the FIDE approved size of the chess pieces as well.

Do Chessbazaar have the option to buy these pieces with boards? If yes then then how can I match the right size with the pieces?

Yes sure, we have made some combos of the Economy Tournament Chess Pieces with right sized board. Browse the collection from our Tournament chess set category. Also, there is a option to choose the right size of the board once you go to the product page of chess pieces.

What's the standard measurement of these pieces?

The king in this category is 3.75" tall and the rest of the pieces are proportionately smaller than that.

How prompt did I get these economy tournament chess pieces from Chessbazaar?

To Europe and US we ship the items by FedEx/DHL expedited and you can expect these in 4-5 working days. For the rest of the countries you can see the particular product for details on shipping times.

Economy tournament chess pieces are the most affordable chess sets in the chess pieces category. They make an excellent gift for any occasion and for all age groups.
